Agent-only Playwright driver for launching and clicking through the Electron app during development; its `eval` REPL command deliberately runs developer-typed JS inside the app's page for debugging. Not part of the shipped app (excluded from package.json's build.files).

App Check broker page loads Google's own reCAPTCHA Enterprise script via a pinned, hardcoded https://www.google.com/recaptcha/enterprise.js URL, exactly as Firebase's own documentation requires; the URL is not derived from user input. It runs only inside a hidden, sandboxed, contextIsolated Electron window on Nexus's own Hosting origin, never in the app's normal UI (see appCheckBroker.js and test/appCheckBroker.test.js).
